Your {c_important}Demonology{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|1%x|]{/c} increased damage per Dominance you have and you take {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*Affix."Static Value 2"*100|2%+|]{/c} reduced damage per Wrath you have. 
In {c_important}{u}Demonform{/u}{/c} you lose {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"*100|%|]{/c} Wrath each second but gain {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"*100|%|]{/c} Dominance per kill, otherwise you lose {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"*100|%|]{/c} Dominance each second but gain {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 3"*100|%|]{/c} Wrath per kill.
